comment: Countries are advised to choose two or three priority health goals. The seven goals are broad, and selecting complete goals may still produce programmes that are too large for an initial implementation.

anchor.note: p.89 l.Lines 48-53 read as the printed page; section 4.1.2 agrees

public.text: Countries are advised to choose two or three priority health goals. The seven goals are broad, and selecting complete goals may still produce programmes that are too large for an initial implementation.
public.suggestedRevision: Select bounded, high-value use cases within priority goals and document their users, workflows, information needs, expected outcomes, architectural dependencies, and scale pathway.
